violation_description: Submit false documents to evade the payment or reduce VAT due or unlawfully obtain refunds
penalty: At least VAT due, up to 3x the goods/service value

violation_description: Move or attempt to move goods in or out of the Kingdom without paying the VAT due
penalty: At least VAT due, up to 3x the goods/service value

violation_description: Failure to apply for VAT registration
Failure to submit the Tax Return

penalty: 5% of unpaid tax monthly or partial month

violation_description: Issuance of Tax Invoice by non-registered Person
Failure to keep Tax Invoices, books, records and accounting documents
Prevention or obstruction of ZATCA employees from performing duties
Violation of any provision of the VAT Regulations or the VAT Law
Filing incorrect tax return, amend a tax return or file any document resulting in a lower amount due
penalty: 50% of difference between calculated and actual tax due
